name: House Hopped Beer
description:
The house beer is amber, plainly hopped and easy to pair with a meal. A chalk mark on the cask records when the brewer delivered it.

One purchase supplies one pint of beer. The inn retains its serving vessel; takeaway requires your own suitable container. Alcohol effects are left to the GM.
